function.name: create_draft
function.description: Create an email draft in the user's Drafts folder. The draft is not sent; the user will review and send it. Use inReplyTo to draft a reply to an existing email.

body.description: Plain text body of the email

inReplyTo.description: Id of the email being replied to, as returned by search_emails

function.name: search_emails
function.description: Search the user's emails. Returns a list of matching emails with id, sender, subject, date and a short preview. Use the returned id with create_draft to reply to an email.

keyword.description: Text to search in subject and body

after.description: Only emails received after this date (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-14)

limit.description: Maximum number of results, default 10, max 20
